system.notes: Same appliance as 2026.11.1-beta, published so a card flashed with 2026.11.1-beta has a newer system to update to — the first exercise of the OS partition path.

proxy.notes: Green used as words can be read on every surface, on both consoles. Drivers report their own heap, allocation rate and thread pool over a heartbeat, and a driver too old to answer says so rather than reporting a zero. The webOS idle-gap guard is documented where it is, rather than folded onto a narrower one. The OS image moves to 2026.11.2-beta, whose boot slot can be found by name — without which a card customised in Raspberry Pi Imager reboots into the same arguments for ever.
